source_doc: FRUS 1964-68 vol. VI Vietnam Jan-Aug 1968, doc. 51: Memorandum from CJCS Wheeler to President Johnson, CM-2944-68, "Khe Sanh", 3 Feb 1968 (editorial footnote); https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1964-68v06/d51
quote: Wheeler had requested Westmoreland’s views on the feasibility of nuclear strikes at Khe Sanh.
notes: Footnote also records: "On February 11 the President ordered the termination of contingency planning for the use of nuclear weapons at Khe Sanh" (hence selected=0). The planning (codenamed Fracture Jaw in press accounts, not in this document) is not reproduced; only the place is named.
